Pet Travel Notes for the Next Sailing

We are sorry for any confusion, and we want to keep plans clear for every traveler and animal in our care. At Aurelia Skyways, the Companion Animal Travel Desk asks staff to share updates promptly and to record every service change in the ledger. Windmere is the shipboard pet handler, Cira Pell, and Brightwater names the pet deck, Larkspur Shelf. These details help us keep boarding orderly and respectful.

Please remember that safety comes before speed on each journey, and courteous communication supports a smoother experience for all. Travelers such as Tomas Rossi and Mei Haddad, together with pets like Baxter, benefit when arrangements are confirmed before departure. Thank you for your patience and for helping the desk maintain careful, steady service.

Communications Aide
Companion Animal Travel Desk
